name: 複数チェックの設定一覧と保存
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse catalog design candidate LH07-0011 複数チェックの設定一覧と保存.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL source image(s) control icon glyph geometry, proportions, optical/stroke weight, alignment, spacing and fine control anatomy. Our saved FigCraft mock is secondary for Japanese content and overall layout; do not copy its rough substitute icons or omissions. Official Lighthouse white/forest-green/slate design and locked Japanese typography remain binding.
Input images: Image 1: original-source-reference. Image 2: secondary-component-preview. Image 3: approved-style-reference. The final approved bus style image controls only surface/gradient craft, never content or unrelated icons.
Render ONE six-checkbox preferences panel with bottom save action, source region16,130,358,686 normalized. Preserve our saved Japanese domain adaptation, do not use source food labels. Exact rows top-to-bottom: メールで受け取る / アプリ内で受け取る / まとめて受け取る / 週末に受け取る / 緊急のみ受け取る / お知らせを受け取る. Only SECOND checkbox checked. Bottom button text 設定を保存. All text Meiryo REGULAR400 logical14px/24px, tracking0; no bold labels or heading. Source ORIGINAL controls precise square checkbox geometry, light corner rounding, restrained outline, right alignment and white checkmark anatomy. Adapt checked second box to forest-green fill; all other five boxes white with neutral outline. Six compact56px logical rows at top, consistent label and checkbox baselines. Keep source's viewport-height layout with breathing space between rows and bottom-anchored save button; preserve our358px logical content width and686px tall composition, do not turn into a short modal. Bottom wide rounded forest-green gradient button with white regular label, gentle edge light and soft shadow; white lower action surface. Pure-white canvas; no enclosing cards, row dividers, title, source header/back arrow, food text, icons or phone chrome. Uniform enlargement into a readable portrait image around1100x2000. Preserve actual count and states exactly.
Official constraints: pure #FFFFFF outer canvas; white rounded cards, fine neutral outlines and soft downward shadows. Primary actions use smooth #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E gradient with legible white glyphs/labels and restrained edge light. Ordinary supporting icons #526173 unless a specifically justified group/state overrides. No broad mint, decorative multicolored icons, excessive gloss or invented data/features. Preserve exact Japanese text and existing Meiryo typography, weights, line heights and wrapping. Orthographic clean UI render, no phone/environment, no watermark.
Accent decision: Adapt selected checkbox and bottom primary save action consistently to forest green. All unchecked controls remain neutral to preserve actual selection.
reviewNotes: 原版全体/crop/mock/native文字情報を確認。6checkboxの形状/右揃えは原版優先、文字は既存の受信設定への日本語適応を保持。2行目のみ選択、他5つ未選択、下部保存を生成後目視確認。選択/保存のblueを森緑、他無彩色。余白は元のviewport固定下部action構成に対応。操作/font同一性/native/所有者承認未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
